title: Foley Railroad Museum

services.name: Model Train Exhibit
services.desc: Don’t miss Foley’s Model Train Exhibit, a delightful O scale model train display that covers 1,200 square feet of table top. The engineers who run the trains love what they do and enjoy answering questions about the custom layout that they created. Multiple freight trains and passenger trains crisscross the layout that includes a very detailed model town, a farming community, a country fair, a potato shed, an outdoor drive in and tall wooden trestle bridges with tunnels. The model train exhibit is free and open on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays from 10 a.m. until 3 p.m. It’s a great place to spend time with children or anyone who loves model
